连音:안+녕 → [안녕],하 前 ㅇ 无声;敬语 -세요 表礼貌请求.en: Linking: 안+녕 → [안녕], ㅇ before 하 is silent; -세요 is a polite request ending

正式敬语终结词尾 -ㅂ니다,写作 습니다.en: Formal polite ending -ㅂ니다, written as 습니다

찮 双收音 ㄴㅎ,连音 ㅎ 脱落 → [괜차나요],最容易漏写 ㅎ.en: 찮 has double final ㄴㅎ, ㅎ drops in linking → [괜차나요], ㅎ is most often omitted in spelling

겠 表意志 · 结尾 습니다,不是 슴니다.en: 겠 expresses intention · ending is 습니다, not 슴니다

먹었 过去时 → [머걷] · 겠→었 意志变过去.en: 먹었 past tense → [머걷] · 겠→었 intention becomes past

双收音 ㄶ · 어떤/어떻다 同词根.en: double final consonant ㄶ · 어떤/어떻다 share the same root

단음节 · 双元音 ㅙ,不是 ㅞ 也不是 ㅚ.en: single syllable · diphthong ㅙ, not ㅞ nor ㅚ

어(open ㅓ)+디 · 疑问词无收音.en: 어(open ㅓ)+디 · question word has no final consonant

무엇 的口语缩略;/mwo/,不写 머.en: colloquial contraction of 무엇; /mwo/, not written as 머

单收音 ㄴ · 后接 제 无连音.en: Final consonant ㄴ · no liaison before 제

ㄴ 起首 · 与 뉘/누 区分.en: Starts with ㄴ · distinguish from 뉘/누

既是\"是\",也是\"你的\"(너의缩略);短音.en: Means both "yes" and "your" (contraction of 너의); short vowel

尾用 요 保礼貌 · 아니오 是命令式,场景不同.en: End with 요 for politeness · 아니오 is imperative, different context

ㅀ 双收音 → [시러요] · 连音丢 ㅎ.en: ㅀ double final consonant → [시러요] · liaison drops ㅎ

예쁘+ㅓ요 · 으 脱落变 예뻐요.en: 예쁘+ㅓ요 · 으 drops out to become 예뻐요

ㅇ 起首无音;短音 ·\"今天\"不带助词也能做时间状语.en: ㅇ at start has no sound; short vowel · "today" can be a time adverbial without a particle

내+일 · 常与今日 오늘 对比.en: 내+일 · often contrasted with today 오늘

ㅓ 起首;时间状语用 어제,不用 어제에.en: ㅓ at start; use 어제 for time adverbial, not 어제에

ㅈ+ㅣ · 与 조금(一点) 混淆:量 vs 时间.en: ㅈ+ㅣ · confused with 조금 (a little): quantity vs time

既指\"早上\"也指\"早餐\",看语境.en: Refers to both "morning" and "breakfast," depending on context.

既指\"中午\"也指\"午餐\",看语境.en: Refers to both "noon" and "lunch," depending on context.

固有数词 · 与量词搭配变 한(한 잔/한 명).en: Native numeral · changes to 한 with counters (한 잔/한 명).

固有数词 · 与量词搭配变 두(두 잔).en: Native numeral · changes to 두 with counters (두 잔).

固有数词 · 与量词搭配变 세(세 명).en: Native numeral · changes to 세 with counters (세 명).

固有词 · 人;敬语用 분.en: Native word · person; honorific is 분

ㄱ 起首 · 汉字词 · 复数用 가족들.en: Starts with ㄱ · Sino-Korean · plural is 가족들

尾音 ㅂ · 敬语用 댁.en: Final consonant ㅂ · honorific is 댁

女生对姐姐/年长女性;男生说姐用 누나.en: Used by females for older sister/older woman; males say 누나

女生对哥哥/年长男性;男生说哥用 형.en: Used by females for older brother/older man; males say 형

男女不分 · 加 남/여 区分 남동생/여동생.en: Gender-neutral · add 남/여 to specify: 남동생/여동생

尾音 ㄹ · 后接 ㄴ 流音化 [할머니].en: Final ㄹ · followed by ㄴ causes liquidization [할머니]

既\"头\"也\"头发\";没有 ㅁ+ㅓ 连音陷阱.en: Means both "head" and "hair"; no ㅁ+ㅓ liaison trap

一词两义 · 短音=眼睛,长音=雪.en: One word, two meanings · short vowel=eye, long vowel=snow

ㄱ 起首;既指\"肉\"也指\"鱼/肉类\".en: Starts with ㄱ; means both "meat" and "fish/meat"

汤类总称;单音节名词.en: General term for soups; single-syllable noun

김 韵尾 ㅁ,不写成 긴치.en: 김 ends with ㅁ, not written as 긴치

硬音 ㅃ · 색 尾 ㄱ 内爆.en: Tense ㅃ · final ㄱ is unreleased

双元音 ㅢ · 词尾常读 [히니].en: Diphthong ㅢ · often pronounced [히니] at word end

尾音 ㄴㅈ 发 [ㄴㅉ] 紧音.en: Final consonant ㄴㅈ pronounced as [ㄴㅉ] tense sound

尾音 ㄷ 遇到辅音发 [t].en: Final consonant ㄷ pronounced as [t] before a consonant

双收音 ㄺ,单独发 [익].en: Double final consonant ㄺ, pronounced as [익] alone

재미 名词+있다,不是 재미이다.en: 재미 is a noun + 있다, not 재미이다

同形副词 · 안 먹다=不吃,안=里面.en: homonym adverb · 안 먹다=not eat, 안=inside

계산 汉字词 · 결제 也可(现代多用 결제).en: 계산 Sino-Korean · 결제 also possible (결제 more common in modern usage)

ㄱ 起首;火车不含地铁.en: starts with ㄱ; train does not include subway

外来词 · 韩语无对应汉字.en: loanword · no corresponding Hanja in Korean

短音 · 单音节 · 与 배(船/肚子) 区分.en: Short vowel · single syllable · distinguish from 배 (boat/stomach)

长音=雪,短音=眼睛.en: Long vowel = snow, short vowel = eye

硬音 ㄸ 双 · 尾 ㅅ 遇 ㅎ → [따뜨타다] 激音化.en: Tense ㄸ double · final ㅅ meets ㅎ → [따뜨타다] aspiration

尾 ㅅ 内爆 [옫] · 复数 옷들 无连音.en: Final ㅅ is unreleased [옫] · plural 옷들 no liaison

词尾 ㅢ 可读作 [ㅣ] · [회이].en: Final ㅢ can be read as [ㅣ] · [회이]

ㄹ 收音后 ㅍ 保持,不硬音.en: After ㄹ final consonant, ㅍ remains, not tensed

화(火)+나다(起) · 화가 나다 更常见.en: 화(火)+나다(come up) · 화가 나다 is more common

汉字词 · 尾 ㄱ 内爆.en: Sino-Korean word · final ㄱ is unreleased

接续副词 · 表原因结论,后接结论.en: Connective adverb · indicates cause/conclusion, followed by the result

ㄹ 后 ㄷ 硬音化 [갈뜽].en: ㄹ followed by ㄷ becomes tense [갈뜽]

压力大的时候就听歌。.en: When I'm stressed, I listen to music.

最近年轻人对环保的关注越来越高。.en: Recently, young people's interest in environmental protection has been growing.

我认为通过经验可以学到很多东西。.en: I think you can learn a lot through experience.

以后想更努力学习，在韩国公司工作。.en: In the future, I want to study harder and work at a Korean company.

在现代社会中，沟通的重要性越来越大了。.en: In modern society, the importance of communication is growing.

每个人都有被平等尊重的权利。.en: Everyone has the right to be treated with equal respect.

为了成功，需要持续的努力。.en: To succeed, you need continuous effort.

我认为理解彼此不同的文化很重要。.en: I think it's important to understand each other's different cultures.

技术的发展极大地改变了我们的生活。.en: The development of technology has greatly changed our lives.

尊重文化多样性在全球化时代是必不可少的。.en: Respecting cultural diversity is essential in the era of globalization.

在个人自由与社会责任之间寻求平衡非常重要。.en: Finding a balance between personal freedom and social responsibility is very important.

低出生率问题仅靠经济支持难以解决。.en: The low birth rate problem is difficult to solve with economic support alone.

教育的目的不仅是传授知识，更是培养批判性思维能力。.en: The purpose of education is not just to impart knowledge, but also to cultivate critical thinking skills.

随着在线教育的普及，教育机会的不平等正在逐渐改善。.en: With the spread of online education, inequality in educational opportunities is gradually improving.

人工智能的发展将给就业结构带来根本性变化。.en: The development of artificial intelligence will bring fundamental changes to the employment structure.

利用大数据可以实现更高效的决策。.en: Using big data can enable more efficient decision-making.

为解决环境问题，个人、企业和政府需要共同努力。.en: To solve environmental problems, individuals, businesses, and governments need to work together.

为实现碳中和，能源转型迫在眉睫。.en: To achieve carbon neutrality, the energy transition is urgent.

同时追求经济增长与环境保护是可持续发展的核心。.en: Pursuing economic growth and environmental protection simultaneously is the core of sustainable development.

全球化使得国家间的经济相互依存度提高了。.en: Globalization has increased the economic interdependence among countries.

收入不平等问题是阻碍社会融合的重要因素。.en: Income inequality is an important factor hindering social integration.

创造力和创新已成为现代社会竞争力的核心要素。.en: Creativity and innovation have become core elements of competitiveness in modern society.

不惧失败的挑战精神是成长的驱动力。.en: The spirit of challenge that does not fear failure is the driving force for growth.

努力理解他人的观点是解决冲突的第一步。.en: Making an effort to understand others' perspectives is the first step to resolving conflicts.

通过媒体素养教育，应培养对虚假信息的辨别能力。.en: Through media literacy education, the ability to discern false information should be cultivated.

随着社会对心理健康的认识提高，相关服务也在扩大。.en: As society's awareness of mental health increases, related services are also expanding.

志愿服务活动不仅有助于个人成长，也对社区发展有所贡献。.en: Volunteer service activities not only contribute to personal growth but also to community development.

代际沟通的缺失可能引发各种社会问题。.en: The lack of intergenerational communication can lead to various social problems.

在继承传统文化的同时，也需要努力进行现代诠释。.en: While inheriting traditional culture, efforts must also be made for modern interpretation.

在多元文化社会中，相互尊重与理解是社会融合的基础。.en: In a multicultural society, mutual respect and understanding are the foundation of social integration.

为提高工作效率，明确目标设定和优先级确定非常重要。.en: To improve work efficiency, it is very important to set clear goals and determine priorities.

团队合作能够实现超越个人能力的成果。.en: Teamwork can achieve results that go beyond individual capabilities.

没有持续的自我提升，难以适应瞬息万变的社会。.en: Without continuous self-improvement, it is difficult to adapt to a rapidly changing society.

健全的民主需要公民的积极参与。.en: A healthy democracy requires the active participation of citizens.

新闻自由是民主的基石，但随之而来的责任同样重要。.en: Freedom of the press is a cornerstone of democracy, but the accompanying responsibility is equally important.

针对老龄化社会重新设计福利政策是紧迫的课题。.en: Redesigning welfare policies for an aging society is an urgent task.

基于科学依据的政策制定变得越来越重要。.en: Evidence-based policy-making is becoming increasingly important.

在数字化转型时代，个人信息保护已成为核心课题。.en: In the era of digital transformation, the protection of personal information has become a core issue.

随着远程工作的普及，人们对工作与生活平衡的认识正在改变。.en: With the spread of remote work, people's awareness of work-life balance is changing.

营造公平竞争环境是社会发展的前提条件。.en: Creating a fair competitive environment is a prerequisite for social development.

合作与竞争看似对立，但可以相互补充。.en: Cooperation and competition may seem opposed, but they can complement each other.

对社会弱势群体的关怀是成熟公民社会的尺度。.en: Care for socially vulnerable groups is a measure of a mature civil society.

解决问题的能力是比单纯知识更重要的核心素养。.en: The ability to solve problems is a core competency more important than mere knowledge.

正确的历史认识为下一代指明正确的方向。.en: A correct understanding of history points the next generation in the right direction.

消费模式的变化也对企业的生产方式产生了重大影响。.en: Changes in consumption patterns have also had a significant impact on how companies produce.

建立应对自然灾害的系统性体系刻不容缓。.en: Establishing a systematic framework for responding to natural disasters is urgent.

语言不仅是沟通工具，更是文化与身份的表达。.en: Language is not just a communication tool, but an expression of culture and identity.

在全球化时代，外语能力已不是选择，而是必需。.en: In the era of globalization, foreign language ability is not a choice but a necessity.

灵活适应社会变化的能力是未来人才的核心素质。.en: The ability to adapt flexibly to social changes is a core quality of future talent.

接纳多元观点的开放态度是创造性思维的基础。.en: An open attitude that embraces diverse perspectives is the foundation of creative thinking.

为解决社区问题，居民的自发参与非常重要。.en: To solve community problems, residents' voluntary participation is very important.
